title: @graph
description: a graph under @graph: nodes by id and edges by source and target, or a bare map of nodes whose list-valued keys are edge types; labels, types and property keys are identifiers

nodes.description: the nodes, keyed by id; a node's label is a string or a list of strings, and every other key is a property

edges.description: the edges; source and target are node ids, type is the relationship type, and every other key is a property
